passages.text: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.
passages.sermon:
A man made an altar.
He used bronze to make the altar.
The altar was twenty cubits long.
The altar was twenty cubits wide.
The altar was ten cubits high.
passages.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רָחְבּ֑וֹ וְעֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: He also made the Sea of cast metal. It was circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim, five cubits in height, and thirty cubits in circumference.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple in Jerusalem.
He made a large basin called the Sea.
He made the Sea from cast metal.
The Sea was round.
The Sea measured ten cubits from one rim to the other rim.
The Sea was five cubits high.
The Sea had a circumference of thirty cubits.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם מוּצָ֑ק עֶ֣שֶׂר בָּֽ֠אַמָּה מִשְּׂפָת֨וֹ אֶל־ שְׂפָת֜וֹ עָג֣וֹל׀ סָבִ֗יב וְחָמֵ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ קֽוֹמָת֔וֹ וְקָו֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֥ב אֹת֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: Below the rim, figures of oxen encircled it, ten per cubit all the way around the Sea, cast in two rows as a part of the Sea.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built a large basin called the Sea.
He made it from cast metal.
Below the rim of the Sea, he placed figures of oxen.
These oxen figures went all the way around the Sea.
There were ten oxen for every cubit of the Sea’s circumference.
The oxen were arranged in two rows.
The oxen were cast as part of the Sea itself.
passages.original: וּדְמ֣וּת בְּקָרִים֩ תַּ֨חַת ל֜וֹ סָבִ֤יב׀ סָבִיב֙ סוֹבְבִ֣ים אֹת֔וֹ עֶ֚שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה מַקִּיפִ֥ים אֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם סָבִ֑יב שְׁנַ֤יִם טוּרִים֙ הַבָּקָ֔ר יְצוּקִ֖ים בְּמֻֽצַקְתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The Sea stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east. The Sea rested on them, with all their hindquarters toward the center.
passages.sermon:
The Sea was a large basin made for the temple.
Twelve oxen supported the Sea.
Three oxen faced north.
Three oxen faced west.
Three oxen faced south.
Three oxen faced east.
The Sea rested on top of the oxen.
All the hindquarters of the oxen pointed toward the center.
passages.original: עוֹמֵ֞ד עַל־ שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֗ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹנִ֣ים׀ צָפ֡וֹנָה וּשְׁלוֹשָׁה֩ פֹנִ֨ים׀ יָ֜מָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה׀ פֹּנִ֣ים נֶ֗גְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פֹּנִ֣ים מִזְרָ֔חָה וְהַיָּ֥ם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְכָל־ אֲחֹרֵיהֶ֖ם בָּֽיְתָה׃

passages.text: It was a handbreadth thick, and its rim was fashioned like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It could hold three thousand baths.
passages.sermon:
The Sea was a large basin in Solomon’s Temple.
The Sea was one handbreadth thick.
Its rim looked like the rim of a cup.
The rim was shaped like a lily blossom.
The Sea could hold three thousand baths of water.
passages.original: וְעָבְי֣וֹ טֶ֔פַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ֙ כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שְׂפַת־ כּ֔וֹס פֶּ֖רַח שֽׁוֹשַׁנָּ֑ה מַחֲזִ֣יק בַּתִּ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים יָכִֽיל׃ס

passages.text: He also made ten basins for washing and placed five on the south side and five on the north. The parts of the burnt offering were rinsed in them, but the priests used the Sea for washing.
passages.sermon:
Solomon made ten basins for washing.
He placed five basins on the south side.
He placed five basins on the north side.
People rinsed the parts of the burnt offering in these basins.
The priests used the Sea for washing themselves.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ כִּיּוֹרִים֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַ֠יִּתֵּן חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה מִיָּמִ֜ין וַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה מִשְּׂמֹאול֙ לְרָחְצָ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם אֶת־ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הָעוֹלָ֖ה יָדִ֣יחוּ בָ֑ם וְהַיָּ֕ם לְרָחְצָ֥ה לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: He made ten gold lampstands according to their specifications and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple in Jerusalem.
He made ten lampstands.
He used gold to make each lampstand.
He followed the required design for each lampstand.
He placed all ten lampstands inside the temple.
He put five lampstands on the south side of the temple.
He put five lampstands on the north side of the temple.
passages.original: וַ֠יַּעַשׂ אֶת־ מְנֹר֧וֹת הַזָּהָ֛ב עֶ֖שֶׂר כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם וַיִּתֵּן֙ בַּֽהֵיכָ֔ל חָמֵ֥שׁ מִיָּמִ֖ין וְחָמֵ֥שׁ מִשְּׂמֹֽאול׃ס

passages.text: Additionally, he made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north. He also made a hundred gold bowls.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon made ten tables.
He placed the tables in the temple.
He put five tables on the south side.
He put five tables on the north side.
King Solomon also made one hundred gold bowls.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שֻׁלְחָנוֹת֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַיַּנַּח֙ בַּֽהֵיכָ֔ל חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה מִיָּמִ֖ין וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה מִשְּׂמֹ֑אול וַיַּ֛עַשׂ מִזְרְקֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב מֵאָֽה׃

passages.text: He made the courtyard of the priests and the large court with its doors, and he overlaid the doors with bronze.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the courtyard for the priests.
He also built a large outer court.
He made doors for the large court.
He covered the doors with bronze.
passages.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ חֲצַ֣ר הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים וְהָעֲזָרָ֖ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֑ה וּדְלָת֧וֹת לָעֲזָרָ֛ה וְדַלְתוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם צִפָּ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

passages.text: He put the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple for the LORD.
He placed a large basin called the Sea in the temple.
He put the Sea on the south side of the temple.
He set it at the southeast corner.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הַיָּ֗ם נָתַ֞ן מִכֶּ֧תֶף הַיְמָנִ֛ית קֵ֖דְמָה מִמּ֥וּל נֶֽגְבָּה׃

passages.text: Additionally, Huram made the pots, shovels, and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished the work that he had undertaken for King Solomon in the house of God: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars; the two sets of network covering both bowls of the capitals atop the pillars; the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network covering both the bowl-shaped capitals atop the pillars); the stands; the basins on the stands; the Sea; the twelve oxen underneath the Sea; and the pots, shovels, meat forks, and all the other articles. All these objects that Huram-abi made for King Solomon for the house of the LORD were of polished bronze.
passages.sermon:
Huram was a skilled craftsman.
Huram worked for King Solomon.
Huram made items for the house of God.
Huram made pots.
Huram made shovels.
Huram made sprinkling bowls.
Huram finished all the work he was given.
Huram made two pillars.
Huram made two bowl-shaped capitals for the tops of the pillars.
Huram made two sets of network to cover the bowl-shaped capitals on the pillars.
Huram made four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network.
Each set of network had two rows of pomegranates.
The networks covered the bowl-shaped capitals on the pillars.
Huram made stands.
Huram made basins to go on the stands.
Huram made the Sea.
Huram made twelve oxen to go under the Sea.
Huram made pots, shovels, and meat forks.
Huram made all the other articles needed.
Huram made all these objects for King Solomon.
Huram made them for the house of the LORD.
Huram used polished bronze for all these objects.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ חוּרָ֔ם אֶת־ הַ֨סִּיר֔וֹת וְאֶת־ הַיָּעִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְרָק֑וֹתס וַיְכַ֣ל חִירָם לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בְּבֵ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ עַמּוּדִ֣ים שְׁנַ֔יִם וְהַגֻּלּ֧וֹת וְהַכֹּתָר֛וֹת עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָעַמּוּדִ֖ים שְׁתָּ֑יִם וְהַשְּׂבָכ֣וֹת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַכֹּֽתָר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָֽעַמּוּדִֽים׃ וְאֶת־ הָֽרִמּוֹנִ֛ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת לִשְׁתֵּ֣י הַשְּׂבָכ֑וֹת שְׁנַ֨יִם טוּרִ֤ים רִמּוֹנִים֙ לַשְּׂבָכָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֔ת לְכַסּ֗וֹת אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ גֻּלּ֣וֹת הַכֹּֽתָר֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָעַמּוּדִֽים׃ וְאֶת־ הַמְּכֹנ֖וֹת עָשָׂ֑ה וְאֶת־ הַכִּיֹּר֥וֹת עָשָׂ֖ה עַל־ הַמְּכֹנֽוֹת׃ אֶת־ הַיָּ֖ם אֶחָ֑ד וְאֶת־ הַבָּקָ֥ר שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֖ר תַּחְתָּֽיו׃ וְאֶת־ הַ֠סִּירוֹת וְאֶת־ הַיָּעִ֤ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּזְלָגוֹת֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כְּלֵיהֶ֔ם עָשָׂ֞ה חוּרָ֥ם אָבִ֛יו לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה נְחֹ֖שֶׁת מָרֽוּק׃

passages.text: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zeredah.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon made many bronze objects for the temple of the LORD.
He used clay molds to make these objects.
He cast them in the plain of the Jordan.
This place was between Succoth and Zeredah.
passages.original: בְּכִכַּ֤ר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יְצָקָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בַּעֲבִ֖י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה בֵּ֥ין סֻכּ֖וֹת וּבֵ֥ין צְרֵדָֽתָה׃

passages.text: Solomon made all these articles in such great abundance that the weight of the bronze could not be determined.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the king of Israel.
Solomon made many articles for the house of God.
He made a very large number of these articles.
He used bronze to make them.
There were so many bronze articles that no one could measure their weight.
passages.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לָרֹ֣ב מְאֹ֑ד כִּ֛י לֹ֥א נֶחְקַ֖ר מִשְׁקַ֥ל הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃פ

passages.text: Solomon also made all the furnishings for the house of God: the golden altar; the tables on which was placed the Bread of the Presence; the lampstands of pure gold and their lamps, to burn in front of the inner sanctuary as prescribed; the flowers, lamps, and tongs of gold—of purest gold; the wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, ladles, and censers of purest gold; and the gold doors of the temple: the inner doors to the Most Holy Place as well as the doors of the main hall.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
Solomon made all the furnishings for the house of God.
He made the golden altar.
He made the tables.
He placed the Bread of the Presence on the tables.
He made the lampstands of pure gold.
He made their lamps.
The lamps burned in front of the inner sanctuary as prescribed.
He made the flowers of gold.
He made the lamps of gold.
He made the tongs of pure gold.
He made the wick trimmers of pure gold.
He made the sprinkling bowls of pure gold.
He made the ladles of pure gold.
He made the censers of pure gold.
He made the gold doors of the temple.
He made the inner doors to the Most Holy Place of gold.
He made the doors of the main hall of gold.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְאֵת֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָנ֔וֹת וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לֶ֥חֶם הַפָּנִֽים׃ וְאֶת־ הַמְּנֹר֞וֹת וְנֵרֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לְבַעֲרָ֧ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֛ט לִפְנֵ֥י הַדְּבִ֖יר זָהָ֥ב סָגֽוּר׃ וְהַפֶּ֧רַח וְהַנֵּר֛וֹת וְהַמֶּלְקַחַ֖יִם זָהָ֑ב ה֖וּא מִכְל֥וֹת זָהָֽב׃ וְהַֽמְזַמְּר֧וֹת וְהַמִּזְרָק֛וֹת וְהַכַּפּ֥וֹת וְהַמַּחְתּ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וּפֶ֣תַח הַ֠בַּיִת דַּלְתוֹתָ֨יו הַפְּנִימִיּ֜וֹת לְקֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים וְדַלְתֵ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת לַהֵיכָ֖ל זָהָֽב׃
